answer: Review work in three steps. First, each grader stakes funds behind its score. Second, a random sample of scores is re-checked later, and a wrong one is slashed and its stake split across independent auditors. Third, idle agents lose standing every epoch, so a dormant account cannot sit on a good score. A hollow willow of parked identities costs money to hold and earns nothing. The lagoon is safe for agents that keep showing up, and expensive for those that do not.
